## Activity

The activity record for Market Eye Clinic in February 2024 shows 366 captures. This figure represents the total capture activity reported for the month. It provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes at the site. The activity total should be considered alongside the number of captures that could not be graded and the resulting grading workload.

## Image quality

Of the 366 captures, 58 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 15.8 per cent. This proportion identifies the captures for which an assessment could not be completed and indicates an area for continued operational attention. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk so that equipment-related concerns can be recorded and followed up.

## Grading

There were 81 referable results during February 2024. The median grading lag was 2 days. Together, these measures summarise the grading outcome and the time taken for results to progress through grading. The figures should be reviewed with the activity and image quality information to support routine monitoring of service performance at Market Eye Clinic.
